name: Westweg (Westliche Variante)
description_md:
The Westweg (Westliche Variante) is a waymarked hiking route in Germany spanning 90.2 km. It features 2879 m of ascent and 3476 m of descent.

This route takes about 31 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and has an easy difficulty derived from distance and ascent. It is part of the national waymarked hiking network and its line matches the official route published by swisstopo. The route passes Basel within 1400 m and Kunstmuseum Basel | Gegenwart within 1500 m.
